body.error: Cross-issue writes need a run to attribute them to (Heartbeat run context). Every agent comment and task update is attributed to a heartbeat run so the cross-issue cap can be counted and the audit trail can name who acted for whom. This request arrived without a valid run, so it could not be contained. Who can act: this agent, once the request carries its own run id. Try this: Send the `X-Paperclip-Run-Id` header with your current run (`$PAPERCLIP_RUN_ID`) and retry.
